items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, there were a lot of other bands on the same label, Charlie Spivak --

ctx.x: And every time there was an ad in Variety or Billboard or any other kind of exploitation, I had it. And I'm sure that Les Brown, Harry James, and everybody else there was wondering, many times, 'What the hell is going on?'
Yeah, there were a lot of other bands on the same label, Charlie Spivak --
